shared_elements: incised linear signs on a flat rock surface
human figure in profile-like schematic pose
justification: Both surfaces show incised human figures with raised arms and a small round disc among linear signs, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A depicts a detailed, canonical scene of two clothed figures facing each other across an offering stand with dense rows of small pictographic script, while B shows a single stick-like figure beside a long undulating serpentine line on otherwise empty rock; the forms, proportions and compositional logic are entirely different.
